exercises.title: Repeat with for
exercises.guide: Inside `main`, loop **three times** and print the counter.

chunks.guide:
Every Rust program starts at `main`.

- `fn` declares a function
- the braces `{ }` hold its body

Type it, following the ghost text.

`for` repeats a block.

`0..3` counts from **0** up to **3**, not including 3.
`println!` prints a line. `{i}` puts the value of `i` in the text.
